summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of GSF bilingual B2B corporate website. Backend APIs fully functional with proper validation. Frontend renders correctly with all sections, bilingual toggle works with persistence, contact form validates and submits successfully, mobile responsive with working hamburger menu. One minor UI issue found with mobile menu close button (pointer interception by SVG child element).

ui_bugs.issue: Close button X icon (SVG) intercepts pointer events, preventing direct click on button. Menu can still be closed by clicking outside or navigating to a page.
ui_bugs.workaround: Click outside menu or navigate to any page to auto-close
